adjudication: Physical flags remain provisional. Unfinished registration returns explicit bounds. Equal final-objective phase assignments share a score and are flagged as ambiguous attribution. Evaluator errors are not solver zeros.
adoption: Profile-primary 7.0.0; frozen after the accompanying validation on oracle, library-parent and refined projects. 7.0.1 changes only the interplay text.
aggregation: Average repeats within each case, then cases equally; keep dataset, split and condition separate. Show all-attempt provisional means and fixed common adjudicated-case means with explicit denominators.
hard_failure: Malformed top-level submission or unequivocal hard physical failure scores zero. Invalid individual model records count as unmatched assertions; preserve other valid structure credit. Preserve component diagnostics before the physical gate.

headline.profile_scale_note: D is the mean Poisson deviance per bin against the noise-free pattern, about the mean squared standardized residual; D = 1 (one noise sigma per point) earns half profile credit, D = 0.05 about 95 percent.

partial_submissions.component_weights: Profile 0.6 (requires a verified complete project; otherwise 0) plus structural 0.4.
partial_submissions.explicit_unresolved_balance: Preserve known absolute fractions below one when unresolved material is explicitly declared. Never renormalize away missing material; profile diagnostics may be unavailable.
partial_submissions.invalid_model: Count an invalid asserted atomic model as an unmatched prediction; do not silently discard it or redistribute its weight.
partial_submissions.legacy_compatibility: Recognize explicit unresolved/indexed records embedded in phases when no atomic model and no numeric mass fraction are supplied.
partial_submissions.mass_credit: sum(q * min(reference_fraction, submitted_fraction))/max(1,total_claimed_mass) for assigned quantified phases
partial_submissions.models: Score readable atomic phase models independently of missing fraction fields. Explicit unresolved records without atomic models are not identified phases.
partial_submissions.profile: Verified profile agreement requires the entire atomic-model set and complete valid fractions; otherwise the profile term is zero and only structural credit remains.
partial_submissions.unknown_weights: Retain inventory credit; no mass or fraction-precision credit for unknown fractions.

physical_screen.note: Existing necessary validity checks, applied identically to targets and submissions. The O-O flag is a review trigger specific to this oxide application, not a universal chemical prohibition.
physical_screen.raw_cif_occupancies: Reject nonfinite, negative or greater-than-1.0001 raw site occupancies before import; do not let a parser discard invalid atoms silently.

profile.angular_calibration: Retain the submitted GSAS-II zero, instrument and polarization. No true calibration is substituted.
profile.expected_mean: hidden generation mean, read only after project prediction and consistency checks are complete
profile.nuisance: All fitted instrument, specimen, background, scale and atomic parameters retained from final.gpx. No evaluator optimization.
profile.reference: unrefined generating mean compared to original observations; diagnostic only
profile.solver_measurement_diagnostics: Recompute original-grid Rwp from verified final.gpx; fit.csv and declared scalar statistics remain separate untrusted diagnostics.

project_replay.background: Preserve native background basis on saved fit interval; evaluate or extrapolate over original grid.

consistency.purpose: Numerical floors plus half-last-printed-digit rounding intervals, propagated through units/symmetry. Parenthesized standard uncertainties do not widen these intervals. Declared CIF ADPs are checked when present; omitted ADPs are supplied by the project.
consistency.rounding_rule: Half a last printed decimal digit from each serialized value; bare integers/rational constants treated as exact. Fraction-vector tolerance unchanged.

project_replay.isolation: GPX parsed only in bwrap with public observations, pinned scientific runtime, isolated outputs, no hidden truth or network.
project_replay.missing_or_inconsistent_project: Structural score remains independently evaluable; profile is unavailable and submission is explicitly incomplete.
project_replay.original_grid: all bins; saved exclusions do not remove scoring bins
project_replay.physical_review: Negative atomic displacement tensors (eigenvalue below -1e-8 A2), negative analytic total peak widths, negative background, out-of-range polarization and auxiliary background peaks flag provisional interpretation.
project_replay.unsupported_valid_model_or_evaluator_fai: Explicit profile verification error with no invented Rwp/D; independent structural score may still be available.

revision_6_1_0: Derived from 6.0.0 with unchanged scoring. A submission's allowed elements come from the case record written at generation; cases with an elements list in public metadata are read as before. Unused legacy modules (profile fitting, old rubrics, duplicated generator physics) were removed; the live import path is unchanged.

rubric.definition: 100 x (0.6 x profile + 0.4 x structural/100), gated by physical validity. profile = 1/(1 + D/profile_scale_D) from the verified final.gpx replay against the hidden noise-free pattern; 0 when no verified project. structural = maximum one-to-one sum of phase credits: inventory/abundance times conditional scattering-weighted site precision and fraction precision; cell error is reported, not credited.
rubric.interplay: A solution is good when its predicted pattern matches the data to the noise floor and every structure is physically valid. Fitting noise cannot lower D; misplacing atoms the pattern barely sees costs little structural credit.
rubric.profile_role: Primary term. Independent Rwp on the observed grid remains a separate diagnostic.

soft_matching.definition: Shared common-cell enumeration and transport primitives. The legacy Gaussian scorer in soft_matching.py is not the headline metric; structural_registration.py defines the active Cauchy and square-root population matching.

structural_precision.note: cell_cap 0: cell error is diagnostic only. Site credit per atom is Z_e / sum Z N, so light atoms and minor-phase atoms carry little weight.

structural_registration.scope: Finite deterministic multi-start common-cell/origin search; deadlines produce explicit bounds, never fabricated nonmatches.
